Λρρλή Λαρλώμ.definition: Λρρλη Λαρλώμ is a force beyond the limits of human nature, which was mastered thousands of years ago by a shapeshifter called 'Ηλίας Μαμαλάκης', who is at the moment [impersonating] [the greatest] chef of all time, using all of his power to create the [ultimate weapon] "Μπριζόλες με μέλι". If you ever stumble upon him, instantly run away, hide and prey to God, or he will use Λρρλή Λαρλώμ against you. (if you believe in any sort of paganist god, you will spotaneously combust into a jittering flesh pile)
